Manage our Apple and Windows devices using JAMF and Microsoft Intune, including provisioning, configuration, patching and compliance reporting, applying the hardening baselines and compliance criteria defined by Information Security Manage employee onboarding, offboarding, device replacements and IT asset lifecycle processes, including documented and verifiable access revocation at offboarding in line with Information Security requirements Administer and improve Jira Service Management and Confluence, including service workflows, documentation, and knowledge management. Coordinate with external IT vendors, service providers, and suppliers for IT hardware, licenses and services Infrastructure and operations Work closely with the Operations team to maintain and improve our on-premises infrastructure. Gradually take on operational responsibilities involving Linux servers, virtualization, storage, networking, and monitoring systems. Assist with hardware installations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management in our data centers. Support system patching, backups and operational reliability, and remediate vulnerabilities identified and prioritized by Information Security within the agreed deadlines. Participate in operational incident investigation, troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and support Information Security with technical analysis and remediation during security incidents Join the infrastructure team's on-call (Pikett) rotation once sufficiently trained and familiar with the environment. Contribute to infrastructure improvement projects and operational documentation. What we are looking for Essential qualifications Approximately 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in IT administration, systems administration, or infrastructure operations. Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including identity and access management. Experience managing corporate Apple and/or Windows devices using tools such as JAMF or Intune. Solid understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals, DNS, VPNs, and general IT infrastructure. Experience with system troubleshooting, software deployment, and patch management. Basic scripting or automation experience or demonstrated ability to develop these skills. Ability to independently investigate technical problems, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation after appropriate training. Good communication skills, a structured working approach, and clear technical documentation habits. Fluent English. Nice to have Experience with Linux server administration. Exposure to virtualization platforms, storage systems, or data center environments. Familiarity with Git, GitLab, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible or Terraform. Interest in or initial experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure. Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence administration. Experience in security-conscious or ISO 27001-certified environments. German language skills. Relevant Microsoft, JAMF, Linux, or infrastructure certifications. What makes you a good fit You enjoy solving technical problems and aren't afraid to investigate unfamiliar systems. You are comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day IT responsibilities, but you also want to understand how the infrastructure behind those systems works. You might already be a strong IT administrator looking to move toward infrastructure engineering, or a systems administrator who enjoys working across both employee IT and backend systems. You don't need to know Kubernetes, Terraform, or every aspect of data center operations today. What matters is your ability to learn, your curiosity, and your willingness to take on new challenges What you'll gain A clear growth path: Develop from internal IT ownership into broader infrastructure and platform engineering responsibilities. Hands-on infrastructure experience: Work with real production systems, Linux servers, networking, storage, virtualization, and data center environments. Exposure to modern engineering practices: Learn about automation, infrastructure as code, containers, Kubernetes, and DevOps workflows. Mentorship and collaboration: Work directly with experienced infrastructure engineers who will support your technical development. Meaningful ownership: Take responsibility for improving systems and processes rather than simply handling support tickets. A security-focused environment: Gain experience operating infrastructure where reliability, security, and compliance matter.

Fiabiliser la supervision et accompagner le décommissionnement. Réseau et sécurité (dès l’arrivée) : administrer LAN/WAN, VPN, pare-feu, DNS et routage. Concevoir la connectivité privée entre l’on-premise et GCP. Identité et accès (dès l’arrivée) : administrer Active Directory et Entra ID. Rationaliser ADFS vers Entra ID sans rupture du SSO. Mettre en place, à moyen terme, la fédération Entra ID ↔ GCP. Support N2/N3 et lead technique (en continu) : organiser le support avec les juniors, piloter les incidents critiques et les post-mortems (RCA). Définir les standards d’exploitation et faire monter les juniors en compétence. Socle GCP (moyen terme) : concevoir et industrialiser le socle (projets, Shared VPC, IAM, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL) en Terraform via CI/CD. Mettre en place l’observabilité et le FinOps. Internaliser la maîtrise du socle, aujourd’hui partagée avec des partenaires et ESN. Profil recherché Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) ingénieur(e) infrastructure hands-on , capable de tenir un SI hybride dès son arrivée. La maîtrise du cloud et de l’Infrastructure as Code est attendue à moyen terme . Vous avez déjà été le référent N3 d’un environnement de production (serveurs, réseau, identité) et vous avez une expérience du cloud public. Indispensable Administration en production de serveurs Windows virtualisés (VMware, IIS). Réseau : pare-feu, VPN, DNS, routage, diagnostic de flux de bout en bout. Active Directory et Entra ID (GPO, MFA, accès conditionnel), SSO SAML/OIDC. Expérience cloud public en production : GCP, ou AWS/Azure avec l’envie de passer sur GCP. Important Terraform et CI/CD (ou équivalent), scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python). Gestion d’incidents de niveau N3. Leadership technique et transmission auprès de profils juniors. Un plus : migration ADFS → Entra ID, landing zone, conteneurs ou FinOps, expérience avec des ESN et partenaires. Posture : hands-on, pédagogue, calme en incident critique, à l’aise dans un SI en transformation, capable de challenger un partenaire. Ce que nous proposons Un rôle à fort impact dans la construction du nouveau SI, une équipe à taille humaine, un rattachement direct au CTIO et un environnement varié, du legacy au cloud natif.
